title: R's Weapon
description: This Mod Adds New Types of Weapon For Fighting and Show Casing.
body:
# R's Weapon R's Weapon is a PvP weapon based mod that brings powerful and fully craftable weapons to your Minecraft world. Minecraft only has 3 weapons to use, 2 of them are only late game item. This mod add six new weapon's in minecraft.
Some of these weapons features custom effect's, They can give buff or debuff to a player. For examply it can give +1 reach or -1 reach depending on the weapon. Click on the spoiler to get the name of weapons. Recommended to use jei(just enough items) for the recipes.
Spoiler 1. Long Sword

2. Fast-Sword

3. Katana

4. Saber

5. Halberd

End Game Weapon

6. Moon Hunter's Scythe
